Obsess about impact, first on onboarding, first session clarity, and engagement loops.
Build and own our design system for speed and consistency across surfaces
Work with product, engineering, and data science to ship high q

description:

Strategy & Analysis

Partner with the Head of Product & CEO on core strategic initiatives (B2B + B2C).

Support partnerships and BD with market research, TAMs, and strategic storytelling.

location: St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, CA
description:
Interim Executive Director
Single Parent’s Association of Newfoundland and Labrador (SPANL)
St. John’s, NL

Step into a role where strong leadership meets real-world impact, guiding an organization that changes lives every day.

The Company

SPANL was founded in September of 1987 by Margaret Acreman. Based on her own experience as a single parent, she recognized the gaps in available services and little awareness of the issues facing single parent families.  Today, the Single Parent Association of Newfoundland and Labrador (SPANL) is a dynamic, non-profit organization dedicated to empowering single parents on their journey to overcome challenges and achieve their goals. Through a comprehensive range of programs and services—including education, emergency assistance, and community supports—SPANL fosters self-sufficiency and resilience in families across the province.

SPANL creates a strong sense of belonging through social initiatives, peer support, and volunteer engagement. With a mission to elevate the quality of life for single parent families while promoting sustainability, collaboration, and inclusivity, SPANL continues to play a vital and respected role in Newfoundland and Labrador’s social fabric.

title: Data Operations Specialist
location: St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
description:
Enaimco’s Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM) platform is the place where integrity work happens, embedding daily operations inside a living system of understanding. By connecting physical assets to relevant, searchable digital data, we embed operational workflows directly inside a continuously updating digital twin. This transforms manual data reconciliation into automated clarity, ensuring every engineering decision is based on a current, complete view.

That complete view is just the foundation. By turning asset data into a continuously learning system, our platform delivers contextualized insights today and lays the groundwork for predictive decision-making tomorrow.
We’re looking for a Data Operations Specialist to own how customer data is structured, cleansed, mapped, and validated as it moves into our platform. This is the role that sets the standard for how we handle the messy industrial data our customers bring us, and the discipline that lets every subsequent implementation be faster, more traceable, and more reliable than the last. You’ll be the person who decides how data should be organized for ingestion and ongoing use, then holds the line on those rules across every project.

title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
NL2 Capital Inc. is a publicly listed company on the TSX Venture Exchange that was established to identify and complete a business combination with a high-quality operating platform. Through its transformative Qualifying Transaction with the Talon Group, NL2 is evolving from a capital pool company into a fully operating public entity, expected to operate as Talon Diversified Holdings Inc. upon closing.

The Talon Group is a Newfoundland and Labrador-based industrial services platform comprised of established operating businesses including Talon Energy Services, Basil Fearn (93) Limited, and Trinity Roofing. Together, these companies serve industrial, commercial, infrastructure, marine, energy, mining, transportation, public sector, and construction markets throughout Atlantic Canada.

This immersive approach equips students with the knowledge, confidence, and real-world skills required to thrive in modern dental practices.  Guided by a collaborative, student-centred culture, Keyin College is committed to educational excellence while fostering the success of its students, faculty, and staff. Joining Keyin means becoming part of an institution dedicated to developing the next generation of skilled healthcare professionals.  The Role  Keyin College is looking for a Dental Faculty Coordinator to lead and support the Level II Dental Assisting Program. description: Venor is proud to partner with InnovMarine on their search for a Senior Sales Engineer to join their growing team! InnovMarine delivers innovative software solutions and consulting services that help organizations optimize complex asset management operations across the maritime, defence, and industrial sectors. Combining deep technical expertise with industry knowledge, InnovMarine partners with organizations to modernize operations, improve decision-making, and unlock greater value through digital transformation and emerging technologies. As InnovMarine continues to expand across Atlantic Canada, they are seeking a Senior Sales Engineer to help grow their presence within the maritime and defence industries. This unique opportunity blends technical pre-sales expertise with consultative enterprise sales, making it ideal for someone who enjoys translating complex business challenges into practical technology solutions. description: Venor is proud to partner with Archibald Drilling & Blasting in their search for an Accountant to join their team in Truro, Nova Scotia. Archibald Drilling & Blasting is a leading provider of drilling and blasting services, with more than 40 years of experience delivering safe, innovative, and reliable solutions across quarry operations, open-pit mining, civil construction, and marine projects. Known for its commitment to safety, technical excellence, and continuous improvement, Archibald supports some of the most complex and demanding projects throughout Atlantic Canada and beyond. Reporting directly to General Manager, the Accountant will play a critical role in the day-to-day financial operations of the business. This is a highly visible and well-rounded position that will touch all aspects of accounting and finance, while helping leadership navigate cash flow management, operational reporting, and continuous process improvement. The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment, bring a proactive and solutions-focused mindset, and be motivated by the opportunity to help modernize and improve financial processes as the business continues to grow. As QuickFacts continues to expand its AI-powered platform, they are seeking a seasoned backend engineer who thrives on building scalable systems, solving complex technical challenges, and developing innovative solutions that deliver meaningful business impact. description:
Version française ci-dessous


Who We Are

MEOPAR is a not-for-profit network funded by the Strategic Science Fund (SSF) that is focused on supporting leading-edge research and connecting top researchers across Canada with highly qualified personnel, partners, and communities. Together, our mission is to address the problems and opportunities of the changing marine environment. MEOPAR funds leading-edge research, overcomes barriers to collaborative research, and helps to train the next generation of marine professionals.

What You’ll Do
